representation: MODRISS JSON DSL mapped to SPEM 2.0

roleDefinitions.name: Product Owner
responsibilities: Product goal, ordered backlog, value decisions, acceptance

roleDefinitions.name: Delivery Lead
responsibilities: Team coordination, dependencies, flow metrics, escalation, retrospectives

roleDefinitions.name: Domain Expert
responsibilities: Business meaning, rules, examples, language, and scenario validation

roleDefinitions.name: Business Modeler
responsibilities: Intent, domain, behavior, process, transformation contracts

roleDefinitions.name: Security & Privacy Engineer
responsibilities: Threats, privacy, compliance, risk acceptance, and control evidence

taskDefinitions.name: Create CIM model root
steps: Create or verify CIMModel with domainName and businessScope.
Set organizationName, modelingDate, and language.
Apply lifecycle status and annotation conventions on the root.
entryCriteria: Project created or existing CIM opened for a new increment

taskDefinitions.name: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
taskDefinitions.purpose: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
steps: Apply the shared identity, annotation, traceability, expression, and lifecycle conventions used by every CIM element.
Set the evidence convention for source references, review status, and model-level provenance.
Confirm that shared support concepts are handled by inspectors and readiness records rather than mistaken for business concepts.
exitCriteria: Shared model contract and evidence convention are recorded

taskDefinitions.name: Plan capability slice
steps: Select one capability or bounded-context candidate from the modeling backlog.
Record slice objective, scope boundaries, assumptions, and definition of done.
Identify the validation gate and review participants for the cycle.
exitCriteria: Capability-slice scope and definition of done are agreed

taskDefinitions.name: Define business goals and KPIs
steps: Capture BusinessGoal elements with success criteria.
Define measurable KPIs linked to each goal.
exitCriteria: At least one goal with linked KPI

taskDefinitions.name: Identify stakeholders
steps: Register stakeholders and their concerns linked to goals.

taskDefinitions.name: Model actors and roles
steps: Model human and system Actor elements with trust levels.
Define Role elements and link to actors.
exitCriteria: Actors exist for primary user journeys

taskDefinitions.name: Register external systems
steps: Register ExternalSystem actors at domain boundaries.

taskDefinitions.name: Map business capabilities
steps: Create BusinessCapability elements linked to goals.
Set criticality for each capability in the increment slice.
exitCriteria: Capabilities cover core value streams for slice

taskDefinitions.name: Record capability dependencies
steps: Model CapabilityDependency relationships between capabilities.

taskDefinitions.name: Define domain glossary
steps: Define UbiquitousLanguageTerm entries with definitions and examples.
Link terms to capabilities where helpful.
Resolve naming conflicts before entity modeling.
exitCriteria: Glossary covers core domain nouns for slice

taskDefinitions.name: Define data classifications
steps: Create DataClassification elements with confidentiality levels.

taskDefinitions.name: Create information items
steps: Create InformationItem elements for each planned entity attribute group.
Set identifiability and data kind on each item.
exitCriteria: Information items exist for planned entities

taskDefinitions.name: Model domain entities
steps: Create DomainEntity elements referencing primary InformationItem identity.
Define lifecycle states and business invariants per entity.

taskDefinitions.name: Model value objects and relationships
steps: Add ValueObject elements for descriptive data.
Model DomainRelationship elements between concepts.
exitCriteria: Relationships and VOs complete for slice

taskDefinitions.name: Model commands and outcomes
steps: Create Command elements with actors and target capabilities.
Define CommandOutcome and link expected/rejection events.
exitCriteria: Commands cover primary write use cases

taskDefinitions.name: Model queries
steps: Create Query elements linked to actors and information items.
Set freshness requirements per query.
exitCriteria: Queries cover primary read use cases

taskDefinitions.name: Model events, errors, and conditions
steps: Create BusinessEvent elements emitted by commands or external systems.
Define BusinessError and Condition elements guarding behavior.

taskDefinitions.name: Define aggregate candidates
steps: Create AggregateCandidate groupings with handled commands and emitted events.
Document consistency and interaction expectations.

taskDefinitions.name: Model business processes
steps: Create BusinessProcess with step hierarchy and transitions.
Connect steps to modeled commands, queries, events, and policies.

taskDefinitions.name: Define policies and decision tables
steps: Create Policy elements guarding commands, events, and processes.
Model DecisionTable with DecisionRule rows for branching logic.

taskDefinitions.name: Synthesize bounded contexts
steps: Group capabilities, entities, CQRS, events, and policies into contexts.
Validate memberships reference concrete modeled elements.

taskDefinitions.name: Formalize requirements
steps: Create Requirement elements with constrains links to domain and behavior.
Add AcceptanceCriterion per requirement.
exitCriteria: Requirements trace to goals and model elements

taskDefinitions.name: Apply governance constraints
steps: Record security, privacy, and compliance constraints on actors and information items.

taskDefinitions.name: Record transformation metadata
steps: Record Risk, Assumption, and Hotspot elements on model hotspots.
Define TransformationProfile for CIM→PIM with manual decisions.

taskDefinitions.name: Complete trace and readiness
steps: Build TraceModel links across goals, requirements, and domain.
Complete ProductionReadinessAssessment and resolve findings.

taskDefinitions.name: Review and adapt CIM increment
steps: Review slice outcomes against goals, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.
Record accepted scope, deferred work, and stakeholder feedback.
Create improvement actions and backlog adjustments for the next engine cycle.
entryCriteria: CIM EVL passes or all blocking findings are dispositioned
exitCriteria: Increment accepted or rework loop selected; improvement actions captured

workProductDefinitions.name: CIM Increment Plan
workProductDefinitions.description: Selected capability slice, working agreements, and definition of done

workProductDefinitions.name: CIM Increment Review Record
workProductDefinitions.description: Review outcomes, accepted slice scope, and improvement actions

guidance.name: Computation-independent intent
guidance.text: CIM captures business meaning without platform or implementation choices. Defer technology decisions to PIM/PSM.

guidance.name: Thin capability slices
guidance.text: Run CIM as an empirical increment cycle: select one valuable capability slice, model only enough breadth to satisfy the slice definition of done, review, then adapt the backlog.

guidance.name: Goal-Question-Metric (Basili)
guidance.text: Anchor every modeling increment with measurable business goals before structural or behavioral elements.

guidance.name: Ubiquitous language first (Evans)
guidance.text: Agree domain vocabulary before modeling entities. Renaming later is expensive. Use glossary tasks early.

guidance.name: Information before entity (CIM-ENTITY-001)
guidance.text: Create InformationItem elements before DomainEntity. Primary identity must reference an information item.

guidance.name: Event storming surface (Brandolini)
guidance.text: Model commands, queries, and events on a behavior surface linked to actors and capabilities before aggregates.

guidance.name: Twin Peaks requirements (Nuseibeh)
guidance.text: Backfill formal requirements after domain structure exists. Use engine rework loops when requirements expose gaps.

sourceOfTruth: The project work tracker stores one process-run record per increment or release candidate.
The model repository stores the model revision, transformation run, validation evidence, and readiness assessment.
The release record stores the exact accepted model, generator, artifact, test, and deployment revisions.

aggregation.rule: Aggregate by increment, team, release, and product; never average away a blocking finding.
aggregation.teamCoordination: Publish a shared dependency board with ownership, dependency type, due date, and escalation path.
aggregation.reviewCadence: Daily local coordination, per-increment review/retrospective, and per-release readiness review.

metrics.name: Eligible task completion
metrics.cadence: each workday and at gate review
metrics.interpretation: Visibility only; never substitute for a usable increment.

metrics.name: Increment flow time
metrics.interpretation: Use trends to tune slice size and expose queues.

metrics.name: Rework rate
metrics.formula: reopened tasks caused by a finding / completed tasks
metrics.interpretation: Inspect causes; do not use as an individual performance score.

metrics.name: Trace coverage
metrics.formula: accepted scope items with source-to-evidence trace / accepted scope items
metrics.cadence: at every level gate and release
metrics.interpretation: A low value blocks confidence even when task completion is high.

metrics.name: Open blocking findings
metrics.interpretation: Must be zero or covered by an explicit, time-bound risk acceptance.

metrics.name: Manual decision closure
metrics.formula: accepted/rejected/waived manual decisions / blocking manual decisions
metrics.interpretation: Open decisions remain visible and are not silently treated as done.

metrics.name: Accepted domain-scope coverage
metrics.formula: accepted slice scenarios with actor, capability, behavior, and acceptance coverage / slice scenarios
metrics.source: CIM increment plan, requirements, and behavior surface
metrics.interpretation: Shows whether modeling breadth matches the selected business slice.

metrics.name: Ubiquitous-language churn
metrics.formula: renamed or conflicted glossary terms reopened after structural modeling
metrics.interpretation: Use as a discovery signal, not as a target to minimize prematurely.

governance.gate: CIM-to-PIM promotion requires structural conformance plus an explicit user/model semantic-validation review; assistant apply/commit uses structural Ecore/EMF conformance only.

processEngine.description: Revolves through increment framing → context discovery → domain exploration → synthesis → readiness/review per capability slice.

deliverable.name: CIM increment slice
deliverable.description: Validated domain, behavior, and governance elements for one bounded slice.

loop.guidance: After the phase-embedded review/adapt stage, revolve the CIM engine for the next capability slice.

reworkLoops.name: Language Refinement Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Entity naming conflicts during structural modeling.
reworkLoops.guidance: Update glossary, then replay information taxonomy and domain structure.

reworkLoops.name: Twin Peaks Exploration Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Behavior modeling reveals missing information items or entities.
reworkLoops.guidance: Extend taxonomy and structure, then resume behavior surface.

reworkLoops.name: Aggregate Boundary Rework
reworkLoops.trigger: Aggregate grouping exposes command/event ownership conflicts.
reworkLoops.guidance: Adjust commands and events, then re-synthesize aggregates.

reworkLoops.name: Process Orchestration Gap
reworkLoops.trigger: Process steps reference behavior not on the CQRS surface.
reworkLoops.guidance: Add behavior elements, then rebuild process flows.

reworkLoops.name: Bounded Context Re-synthesis
reworkLoops.trigger: Context membership is incoherent across aggregates.
reworkLoops.guidance: Revisit aggregates, then re-run context synthesis.

reworkLoops.name: Requirements Twin Peaks Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Requirements cannot be traced to domain or behavior elements.
reworkLoops.guidance: Extend domain model, then re-link requirements.

reworkLoops.name: Readiness Rework Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: EVL or readiness findings identify blocking gaps.
reworkLoops.guidance: Resolve at source stage; replay forward to readiness gate.

processEngine.spemMapping: MODRISS extension realized as an Activity(kind = Iteration) containing process Activities and WorkSequences.

phases.name: Increment Framing
phases.objective: Frame the current capability slice, establish or refresh the CIM program container, and anchor modeling in measurable intent.
entryCriteria: MODRISS project created or prior CIM increment selected for evolution
exitCriteria: Capability-slice objective and definition of done are agreed
At least one BusinessGoal with KPI traces to the slice

stages.name: Program Charter
stages.objective: Create the CIMModel root and modeling conventions on the first cycle; refresh them when the program scope changes.

stages.name: Capability Slice Planning
stages.objective: Select the smallest valuable capability slice and define the cycle-level definition of done.

stages.name: Strategic Framing
stages.objective: Capture measurable business intent for the selected slice using GQM before domain modeling.

phases.name: Context Discovery
phases.objective: Map who participates in the domain, what the organization can do, and shared vocabulary.
exitCriteria: Actors, capabilities, and glossary cover the increment slice

stages.name: Participation Model
stages.objective: Model human/system actors, roles, and boundary external systems.

stages.name: Capability Topology
stages.objective: Map business capabilities to goals and record dependencies.

stages.name: Ubiquitous Language
stages.objective: Build shared glossary before structural modeling (DDD).

iterationLoops.name: Language Refinement Loop
iterationLoops.trigger: Entity naming conflicts during structural modeling.
iterationLoops.guidance: Update glossary, then replay information taxonomy and domain structure.

phases.name: Domain Exploration
phases.objective: Explore information, structure, and behavior using Twin Peaks, iterate until CQRS surface is coherent.
exitCriteria: Commands, queries, and events cover primary use cases

stages.name: Information Architecture
stages.objective: Classify data and name information items before entities (CIM-ENTITY-001).

iterationLoops.name: Twin Peaks Exploration Loop
iterationLoops.trigger: Behavior modeling reveals missing information items or entities.
iterationLoops.guidance: Extend taxonomy and structure, then resume behavior surface.

workflows.name: Expand Increment Scope
workflows.trigger: Stakeholders add a new capability or value stream to the current increment.
steps: Re-enter the engine Plan Increment step; update increment scope annotation on CIMModel.
Replay Discover stage (actors, capabilities, language) for the new slice.
Continue Explore → Construct → Converge for new elements only; merge into existing model.
Re-run traceability and readiness before CIM→PIM.

workflows.name: Add Domain Element
workflows.trigger: A new concept (entity, command, event, process step) is needed outside the current phase.
steps: Identify the metamodel phase that owns the concept (use methodology palette phase hints).
Navigate to that phase; create the element with correct containment and references.
Run Impact Analysis: find trace links, constrains, and bounded-context memberships affected.
Update dependent elements in later phases; mark downstream tasks incomplete if EVL rules break.

workflows.name: Modify Existing Element
workflows.trigger: Rename, restructure, or change attributes/relationships on an existing element.
steps: Record ManualDecision or Annotation describing the change rationale.
Use Impact Analysis to list trace links, requirements constrains, and process transitions affected.
Apply Twin Peaks loop if requirements and structure diverge.
Re-validate EVL rules for all impacted phases before marking tasks complete.

workflows.name: Retire Domain Element
workflows.trigger: A concept is deprecated or removed from scope.
steps: Find incoming references (commands, events, processes, requirements, contexts).
Remove or redirect references; update bounded-context memberships.
Delete the element; run EVL to confirm zero orphan references.
Update TransformationProfile assumptions if CIM→PIM mapping changes.

workflows.name: Post-Transform CIM Change
workflows.trigger: CIM must change after PIM or PSM already exists for this project.
steps: Freeze downstream models or branch increment.
Apply CIM change with full impact analysis.
Re-run CIM EVL and readiness gate.
Re-execute CIM→PIM ETL; reconcile PIM trace links and manual decisions.
Propagate to PSM and artifacts per end-to-end change workflow.
